name: madarek-heron
$doc: R326 M0.4 — the ONE source of truth for the shared Heron design tokens (web + mobile). Provenance: frontend/src/styles/tokens.css (R313/R322/R323/R324 canon) and the r325-era apps/mobile/src/design/tokens.ts hand-copy it replaces. Regen: npm run tokens:build (repo root). Outputs: frontend/src/styles/tokens.generated.css (web CSS vars, imported BEFORE tokens.css, same @layer tokens) + apps/mobile/src/design/tokens.generated.ts (mobile TS). Drift gate: npm run tokens:check (CI-enforced). Reference grammar: 'neutral.50' | 'triad.<family>.<bg|ink|deep>' | 'brand.<key>' | a semantic seat name (another ref, one tier up) | a literal '#hex'. External seat: brand.warmInk emits var(--warm-ink) on web — its definition stays hand-written in tokens.css base :root. NOT shared (deliberately): the web fluid-rem type ladder + font stacks (tokens.css hand section — web-only), the mobile px ladder lives here under typography.mobile; --state-focus-ring-color / --danger-fg / glass / veils / chrome / charts stay hand-written in tokens.css (web-only seats).

brand.$doc: The only three brand colours (R323): paper #F6F6EE · ink #282828 · orange #FA3600 — plus the dark-theme luminous ember #FF5A1F and the warm label ink #191918. Consumed by the RN <Logo> tones and the mobile palette; web emits var(--warm-ink) refs only.

neutral.$doc: The warm vintage-paper ramp (R313). Light: near-white ground #F6F6EE over white surfaces, charcoal ink #282828 (13.57:1 AAA). Dark: the charcoal itself as ground (#282828), surfaces one step up (#2E2E2E), warm hairlines #4A4A48/#5C5C5A, near-white ink. neutral-900 dark is the R324 X22 warm paper twin #F6F6EE (was #F6F8FA — that spelling is on the parity gate's FORBIDDEN list).

triad.$doc: The 9 section families (r305 re-key, engine-verified contrasts): each a soft tinted ground (band fill), a saturated ink for fills/UI accents, a deep shade for text. Badge-rarity pins (yellow/grey/peach deep-vs-bg ≥4.5 both themes) and icon-well pins (light -deep on -bg ≥3:1) verified: mint 7.31 · yellow 7.85 · rose 7.22 · sky 7.74 · peach 6.29 · grey 12.55 · sand 7.62 · lavender 9.24 · copper 6.10. Dark = deep ember-tinted grounds + luminous inks (family ink-on-bg ≥6.5; the ember ink 4.73 AA-large/UI by design).

copper.$doc: The signal family — the ONE vivid orange #FA3600 (the reference's --content--brand). Raw orange is a LARGE-TEXT/UI tone on light (3.53:1); text routes through accentInk #C72E00 (AA). Dark ink is the luminous ember #FF5A1F (4.73:1 AA-large/UI).

semantic.$doc: The role seats components consume. Two-surface rule: bg = PAGE GROUND (paper), surface = CARD GROUND — hierarchy via surface step + hairlines, zero shadows (R313). Light labels on the accent fill read WHITE (AA-large, weight ≥600); body-size accent text routes through accentInk. Dark: luminous ember fills with warm-ink labels; status -ink ≡ the family ink (icon-well no-op).

mobile.$doc: Mobile-only palette seats (no web var counterpart): the hover step and the sheet-overlay ground, expressed as refs so they track the ramps.

tones.$doc: The status-tone families (mobile statusTones / notification & attendance kinds), in display order.

webAliases.$doc: Web-only alias namespace (r305 — the warm secondary of the reference; resolves onto the peach seat). Emitted verbatim into both theme blocks.

spacing.$doc: The 4px-base ladder. `webRungs` carries the HISTORICAL web rung names (the r305 re-key kept the names and re-keyed the values — index ≠ px/4 above --sp-6: --sp-7 IS 32px, --sp-16 IS 240px); `px` is the px-keyed ladder the mobile app consumes. Every webRung value must exist in px with the same value (validated). The --sp-Nx legacy aliases stay hand-written in tokens.css.

radius.$doc: R313: the ladder collapses to 0 — square corners everywhere; ONLY genuinely circular primitives (avatars, status dots) consume full.

motion.$doc: The measured Heron register (r305 census: .4s ×174 dominant; decel standard .23,1,.32,1). Web: the prefers-reduced-motion kill in tokens.css zeroes the rungs by import order. The --ease-out/in/linear/soft/spring family stays hand-written in tokens.css (web-only).

typography.$doc: The mobile px ladder (Arabic 13px readability floor; hierarchy via weight + size, no tracking). The WEB type voice is the fluid-rem ladder + font stacks hand-written in tokens.css (R313) — platform-specific by design, not shared here.
